title: False Branch from the Second Field State
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over Booleans, let $y$ be a Boolean input word, and let $p$ satisfy $1\le p\le |y|$. Suppose the symbol of $y$ at zero-based position $p-1$ is false. For any Boolean flags $f,b$, bit vector, and auxiliary words $w_X,w_C,w_O$, one step of the constructed machine from state $fB$ with input head at position $p$ produces state $cpy$ with the same bit vector and auxiliary words if $f$ is true, and state $fA$ with flag true and the same data if $f$ is false; the input head advances to position $p+1$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine over Booleans
The symbol at position $p-1$ is false
A bit vector of the prescribed length is given
